description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller 'CustomerOptionsSetController' for managing customer option sets within an admin interface. It handles listing, saving, paginating, deleting, and updating customer option sets, interacting with services to perform CRUD operations and rendering views for customer options configuration.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsSetController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing customer option sets for an administrative UI, providing endpoints for listing, creating, updating, paginating, and deleting customer options.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET request to display list of customer option sets, populating model with options, values, and an empty set for the view.

methods.name: saveOptionSet
methods.description: Processes POST request to save a new customer option set after validating associated options and values, and checks for existing associations.

methods.name: pageOptionsSet
methods.description: Handles POST request to paginate and return the customer option sets as a JSON response.

methods.name: deleteOptionSet
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a specified customer option set, verifying store ownership.

methods.name: updateOrder
methods.description: Updates the sort order of a customer option set based on input JSON, returning success or failure.
